S.name: The snake slides to the apple
S.how: Smile, tongue tip behind your bottom teeth, blow a cool breeze: sss.
S.say: Hiss like a snake. The S sound, as in sun, sock and snake.

Z.name: The bee flies to the flower
Z.how: Just like S, but your throat buzzes: zzz.
Z.say: Buzz like a bee. The Z sound, as in zoo, zip and zebra.

SH.name: The train puffs to the station
SH.how: Lips forward, tongue up like a cup, blow warm air: shhh.
SH.say: Shush, like a quiet train, as in ship, shoe and sheep.

F.name: The pump blows up the balloon
F.how: Top teeth on your bottom lip, blow: fff.
F.say: The F sound, as in fish, fan and feet.

M.name: The bear walks to the honey
M.how: Close your lips and hum, as if something is yummy: mmm.
M.say: Hum with your lips closed. The M sound, as in moon, milk and mouse.

L.name: The plane flies to the cloud
L.how: Tongue tip up behind your top teeth, and hum: lll.
L.say: The L sound, as in lion, leaf and lamp.

R.name: The motorbike rides to the finish
R.how: Round your lips a little, pull your tongue back and growl softly: rrr.
R.say: Growl like a little tiger. The R sound, as in rabbit, rain and rocket.

A.name: The rocket flies to the moon
A.how: Open your mouth wide and sing, like at the doctor: aaah.
A.say: Open wide and sing: ah, ah, ah! As in arm, star and car.
